data.content: DU (is an Albanian word) that says "I want".
I want to share with you how everything started…
The Vorae Organization was carrying out an important campaign to promote the rights of communities and opportunities for integration into the world of work.
They wanted to create a campaign that would attract attention and have a real impact, so they contacted us to develop a project that would be powerful and successful.
With a lot of love and dedication, knowing the importance of this initiative, we began working.

We started with an important step: choosing the name for the campaign. We chose the name "DU", which is closely linked to the verb "dua", an Albanian word for “I love, I want” – a word that conveys a strong and pure desire.

The “DU” campaign is focused on promoting equal opportunities for all, addressing both individuals and companies and institutions that support inclusion and diversity. This name has a deep meaning and represents the desires of people from the RAE communities to be present and integrated into the labor market. It was accompanied by slogans like "DU me e shfaqë talentin tem" (I want to show my talent), "DU andrrat mos me m’i thy" (I want my dreams not to be broken), etc.
The use of the word "DU" represents a warm, inclusive, and loving stance – a message from companies that say, “I want you in my company”.
We created the logo for the "DU" campaign, stickers, and also launched it on social media with the aim of making an impact and spreading the message of the campaign in the most powerful way possible.
